description: This source file defines API handlers for exporting and importing board and team archives in the Focalboard application, including route registration, permission checks, and audit logging.

classes.name: API
classes.description: API handler struct for archive-related endpoints in Focalboard.

methods.name: registerAchivesRoutes
methods.description: Registers archive-related API routes to the provided mux router.

methods.name: handleArchiveExportBoard
methods.description: Handles exporting a single board's archive, with permission checks and audit logging.

methods.name: handleArchiveImport
methods.description: Handles importing an archive into a team, with permission checks and audit logging.

methods.name: handleArchiveExportTeam
methods.description: Handles exporting all boards in a team as an archive, with permission checks and audit logging.
